candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from order-service calls to payment timing out: traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory reservation succeeds, and gateway logs show /v1/orders client requests erroring with transport after ~2s, propagating 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side telemetry (its own latency/error metrics) is absent; the timeout is inferred from caller-side spans only. Whether payment is slow or unreachable is unresolved.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show checkout 502s caused by transport ReadTimeout on order->payment calls (~2s), while inventory/redis reservation succeeds. Bounded candidate is downstream latency at payment; payment-side telemetry is missing to fully confirm.
missing_evidence: Payment service server-side latency and error metrics/spans to confirm payment is the slow dependency rather than a network/transport fault
Order service internal spans for the payment call to confirm the timeout originates downstream of order
Baseline latency for payment /v1/authorizations to distinguish regression from steady state
